results_kept.title: Common Changelog
results_kept.snippet: Common Changelog is a style guide for changelogs, adapted from and a stricter subset of Keep a Changelog. It embraces the guiding principle of Keep a Changelog that changelogs must be written by humans and for humans, while recognizing that a clean changelog starts with a clean git history.
